name.description: Display name shown under the avatar.

bio.description: Short description. \n starts a new line. Supports [text](url), **bold**, *italic* and `code`.

avatar.description: Image URL or a path to a file in dist/. Omit to render initials instead.

footer.description: Small bottom-right line. Same inline Markdown as "bio". Omit to hide.

url.description: Canonical URL of the deployed page.

image.description: Optional external 1200×630 social-card image URL. Overrides the generated card when set.

socialCard.description: Settings for the generated 1200×630 social-card PNG.

instance.description: Small site name displayed in the card's upper-left. Defaults to the canonical URL hostname.

description.description: Card-only description. Falls back to bio when omitted; limited to 52 characters to stay on one line.

showAvatar.description: Show the configured avatar in the card's upper-right.

ribbon.description: Bottom color ribbon: resolved social-link colors, custom colors, or none.

ribbonColors.description: Hex colors used when ribbon is custom.

accent.description: Colour for focus rings and non-brand icons.

brandColors.description: Tint each row with its brand colour on hover.

radius.description: Corner radius of the link rows. Use 999px for pill-shaped rows.

keys.description: Keyboard shortcuts: show a hint on each row and jump when that key is pressed.

hideKeyHintsOnMobile.description: Hide desktop keyboard shortcut hints on touch/coarse-pointer devices.

name.description: Row text, and what the icon is matched against (e.g. "GitHub").

label.description: Override the row text while keeping "name" for icon matching.

group.description: Optional heading that groups this link with adjacent links using the same name.

icon.description: Simple Icons slug to force (e.g. "x"), or false for no icon.

key.description: Keyboard shortcut for this row. Omit to auto-assign from the name; false for none.
